what: A bar of the same color runs through the short 1px line placed beside link text like ”view more ———”. While hovered, the bar exits to the right (100%) and re-enters from the left (-100%), repeating every 2.4s ease, and on release the line stands still. With look: always it flows by itself every 1.5s without hover (the line before the subtitle in the Hero). When the line is alone, the element itself becomes the line

options.look: always: Flows constantly without interaction (css is [data-fx-run-line-tail*="look: always"] to select)
options.--fx-dur: Length of one pass, default 2.4s (always is 1.5s)
options.--fx-len: Line length, default 120px (80px when the line is alone) — original is 120/1366 vw
options.--fx-gap: Gap between text and line, default 1em
options.--fx-delay: Delay before the bar starts after hover (seconds), default 0s
options.[data-fx-part=tail]: Spot for the line inside the link (empty span, aria-hidden) — if absent, the element draws the line itself

from.where: shared.css .vn-more (work view more · list cards · careers CONTACT) — original .o-link_note::after with :hover linkNote 2.4s infinite (translateX -100% → 100%), hero subtitle line .o-jumbotron_subtitle-line::after blinkTest2 1.5s infinite
